card.name: Digits in church-history dates and citations
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a year or scripture reference in early church history text, especially fourth-century dates such as 326 or 335 about Alexandria's patriarchs and Athanasius.

modes.label: Fourth-century years
modes.description: A middle digit inside a year in the 300s in text about Alexandrian patriarchs and church councils.

modes.label: Scripture and catechism numbers
modes.description: A digit or dash inside a Bible verse or catechism reference.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unclear, though the suppression of church words suggests it steers away from naming the church after a number.
